identifiers.statement: PR #212 (ct-9vwc): Matches House committee pages by hearing date instead of page date and rejects contradicting embeds, removing 54 false recording_matches and updating 81 recordings / 23 witnesses.

PR #233 (T14a & T17): Syncs live spicy-regs pins (+979 bill_actions, +132/-1 bills, +7,928 member_votes, +562 nominations, +36 roll_call_votes, 691 repaired 118th Senate roll calls, 918 documents[].nomination_id links, schema.json) and excludes WordPress /wp-json/ junk (-87 url_state URLs).

Run 45409095781 daily capture receipts: +2,420 captures, +2,507 readings, 29 Congress.gov meeting_records (16 119th Congress transcript jackets), +52 video_records adding +222 documents/links/sources, 160 untitled-document link_text titles (0 overwrites), and 23 linked GPO mods witnesses.
